card.name: Mixed words in general web prose
card.fires_on: No shared word or setting. The pole dips on scattered words such as a comma, 'more', 'to', 'majority' and parts of 'tufts' in general non-drug web text.
card.plain: It responds to unrelated words in ordinary web text, and no pattern a reader could rely on was found.
